Role guides

Every team has five roles. Each guide explains what the role does, how to play it from early to late game, beginner-friendly champions, and the mistakes to avoid. Not sure which suits you? Try the role picker.

Medium

Top Lane

Top lane is the solo lane at the top of the map. Top laners are usually durable fighters or tanks who win long duels, pressure side lanes, and either lead the charge or protect the team in fights.

Hard

Jungle

The jungler doesn't have a lane. Instead, you farm the monster camps between the lanes, surprise enemy laners with ganks, and lead your team in taking dragons, Void Grubs, Rift Herald and Baron.

Medium

Mid Lane

Mid lane is the short lane through the middle of the map. Mid laners are usually mages or assassins who deal big damage, win the lane with clever trades, and roam to help the jungle and the side lanes.

Medium

Bot Lane (ADC)

Bot lane is played by two players: the ADC (attack damage carry) and the support. The ADC is usually a ranged marksman who farms carefully, scales with items, and deals steady, huge damage in late-game fights as long as they stay alive.

Easy

Support

Supports play bot lane with the ADC but don't need minion gold. Instead, they protect their carry, start fights, place wards, and roam to help other lanes. A great support makes the whole team better.
